old: RSA functions accepted keys of any size, including <1024 bits
new: RSA functions must reject keys smaller than 1024 bits by returning an error from rsa.GenerateKey and all Sign, Verify, Encrypt, and Decrypt methods, unless GODEBUG=rsa1024min=0 is set
evidence_quote:
The proposal is to change crypto/rsa to reject <1024-bit RSA keys by default.
- Return an error from rsa.GenerateKey if bits is less than 1024
- Return an error from all Sign, Verify, Encrypt, and Decrypt methods if the key is smaller than 1024 bits
